one_liner: Connected workspace for docs, wikis, and project management

evidence.claim: API requests authenticate with bearer tokens in the HTTP Authorization header
evidence.quote: The Notion API accepts bearer tokens in this header.

evidence.claim: Public connections use OAuth 2.0; internal connections and PATs use static API tokens
evidence.quote: public connections instead follow the [OAuth 2.0 protocol](https://oauth.net/2/) to authorize a connection to interact with a workspace

evidence.claim: Credentials are self-serve via the Developer portal
evidence.quote: Open Personal access tokens in the Developer portal. ; 2. Select New token. ; 3. Enter a name, select the Notion API capability, and then select Create token.

evidence.claim: API access is available on the free personal plan
evidence.quote: Content API is now moved to Personal Free Plan

evidence.claim: Notion's own GitHub org (makenotion) ships an official MCP server with OAuth install
evidence.quote: Notion MCP Server · Easy installation via standard OAuth. No need to fiddle with JSON or API tokens anymore.

notes: REST base at api.notion.com/v1 with broad surface: endpoint groups for Blocks, Pages, Databases, Data sources, Comments, Views, File Uploads, Search, Users, Custom emojis, plus webhooks and an Admin API. Gotchas: creating an internal connection requires being a workspace owner; pages must be manually shared with a connection before API calls succeed; a public connection's Authorization URL only populates after it is submitted for review; requests require a Notion-Version header. Notion also runs a hosted MCP server at mcp.notion.com alongside the open-source makenotion/notion-mcp-server.
